newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Multipolar says Q1 net up 927 pct.
newsitem.headline: Multipolar says Q1 net up 927 pct.

text.p: Indonesian retailer PT Multipolar Corporation said on Wednesday it posted net profit after tax at 20.1 billion rupiah in the first quarter of 1997, up 927 percent from the year-ago period.
The earnings figure was before amortization of the group's Matahari investment.
The company said in its advertisement that it expected to book a full year net profit in 1997 of 63.2 billion rupiah and revenue of 2.6 trillion rupiah.
In late January, Multipolar -- a unit of the Lippo group -- acquired a 50.1 percent stake in another retailer, PT Matahari Putra Prima.
The two companies are now considered as the retail arm of the Lippo group.
Multipolar said operating profit in the first quarter of 1997 was 65.6 billion rupiah, up 2,302 percent from the same period last year.
The company did not provide further details.
